Subject: Monthly Gas Testing

In order for us to complete our monthly gas testing, please provide the 
following items.

 P&L top sheet for the last day of August.  Additionally, if the majority of 
the P&L pertains to curve shift, please provide the P&L top pages for five 
of  the  largest days including the Curve Shift Reports.
 
  Central Firm
  Central Intra-Month

 P&L top sheet for the last day of September.  Additionally, if the majority 
of the P&L pertains to curve shift, please provide the P&L top pages for five 
of  the largest days including the Curve Shift Reports.

  Central Intra-Month
  FT - West
  FT-Northwest
  Mgmt- West
  West Gas Daily
  Storage (Curve shift reports only)


Thank you in advance for your help.  If you have any questions, please 
contact me at 5-7346.

Sharon
